main.description: Fetch the stored document body and URL for a Gyoka document type.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: Returned when service authentication is required and the caller is not authenticated.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Returned when the authenticated caller is not in the admin allowlist.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: Returned when the query parameters are invalid.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Returned when the requested document has not been stored.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: Returned when the document cannot be loaded.
